lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the third month after the Israelites left Egypt, they came to the desert of Sinai. They camped at the foot of the mountain.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: If you will obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: All the people answered together: "We will do everything the LORD has said."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, with a thick cloud over the mountain, and a very loud trumpet blast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The whole mountain trembled violently. Smoke went up like a furnace. The LORD descended on it in fire.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. You shall have no other gods before me.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Do not misuse the name of the LORD your God. Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy. Honour your father and your mother.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Do not murder. Do not commit adultery. Do not steal. Do not give false testimony. Do not covet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: All that the LORD says, we will do. All that the LORD says, we will obey.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder. Then Moses spoke and the voice of God answered him.
